description: Send a free, no-obligation lie detector test appointment request for a person, directly to the examiner who covers the chosen location. Nothing is paid online and there is no booking fee: the examiner contacts the person, agrees the date, payment and cancellation terms with them, and the person pays the examiner directly. Only use this when the person has asked you to send the request with these details. Returns a booking reference, the office and a page link where the person can see their examiner (and optionally complete a confidential pre-examination questionnaire). Do not put the person's contact details in any URL.

location.description: City, state/region or country for the test, e.g. "Miami", "Florida", "London".

name.description: Full name of the person to be tested (or the person booking).

preferred_dates.description: Preferred date(s)/time(s), free text, e.g. "Aug 5 afternoon or Aug 8 morning" (optional).

service_type.description: One of: single (one person), couple (two people), or group (three or more).

name: start_booking
